title: Silent Embedding of Tape Words
statement: Let $M$ be a Boolean machine with $m$ work tapes, let $\iota$ inject those tape indices into $k$ tape indices, and let $\mathrm{cap}$ be outside the image of $\iota$. Suppose $d$ is an $m$-tape configuration on Boolean input $y$ whose state is $q$, whose input head is at position $1$, whose tape contents are the buffers storing $w(\iota(i))$ on each local tape $i$, whose tape heads are all at position $0$, and whose output is empty; also suppose $w(\mathrm{cap})$ is empty. Then embedding $d$ with the buffer words $w$ and zero head positions, and renaming every state to $\mathrm{finish}$, gives the standard configuration on $k$ tapes with state $\mathrm{finish}$ and tape assignment $w$.
